headline: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 (65) leads the Artificial Analysis index and, after Epoch revised OpenAI's pre-launch score, Epoch's capabilities index too (173.4 against GPT-6.2 Astra's 172.82). GPT-6.2 Astra is second on the Artificial Analysis index with 62 at about $4.00 per task, under a sixth of Fable 5.2's $26.54; Google's Gemini 4 Neon is third with 61 at about $6.44, one point above Gemini 4 Carbon (60), and Claude Opus 5.5 (59) follows. For value, GPT-6.2 Sol scores 57 at about $1.01 per task, Gemini 4 Hydrogen 54 at about $3.16 and GPT-6.1 Terra 51 at about $0.96.

Kimi K3.1 Pro (46) is the best open model, 19 points behind the closed frontier (65) and roughly 4 months behind on Epoch's lag estimate. Tencent published the full Hy4's weights on 20 November, making it the second-best open model (35), ahead of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 (33); Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Small (31) is the best from outside China. Its new Inkling 2 Mini, also out on 20 November, matches Qwen 3.8 27B (20) in a 20 GB download at a sixth of the cost per task.

An open model matching Claude Fable 5.2 (65) is expected around Mar 2027 (range Feb 2027 to May 2027); a version that runs on a desktop under AUD 50k about 2 months later. Today the best desktop model is GLM-5.3-Flash (28) on a 256GB Mac Studio.
